Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de piese pentru autovehicule
Autoliv's primary goal is to Save More Lives. Our products never get a second chance. This is why we can never compromise on quality. We are working to increase vehicle safety by developing seatbelts, airbags and steering wheels and you can be part of our team as Supply Chain Process & Excellence Manager EMEA. 
 The Supply Chain Process & Excellence Manager EMEA designs, governs, standardizes and continuously improves end-to-end supply chain business processes across Planning, Inventory Management, Warehousing, Packaging, Logistics Execution and supporting digital business solutions. The role connects process ownership, operational excellence, analytics and technology to improve service, inventory, cost, productivity and resilience.
 Should you be interested in overseeing these tasks and aiming for enhanced performance standards, your role will involve:
Lead the Supply Chain Process & Excellence organization and coordinate Process Supervisors, Process Owners and analytical resources.
Establish clear ownership and governance across demand, supply and production planning; warehousing and inventory; inbound and outbound execution; packaging; manufacturing and quality interfaces; and sequencing.
Define and maintain process roadmaps, standards, decision rights, maturity assessments and review routines.
Drive harmonization of processes, tools and governance across EMEA operations.
Translate logistics strategy into initiatives, milestones, KPIs and measurable outcomes.
Act as business owner for ERP, planning, WMS, inventory, packaging, analytics and AI-enabled solutions from requirement definition and business case through deployment, adoption and benefit realization.
Lead Lean Supply Chain, process audit, automation and continuous improvement activities.
Develop process-owner capability through competence assessment, training, communities of practice and best-practice sharing.
Strengthen master-data governance, analytics capability, standard dashboards and data-driven decisions.
Support network changes, transfers, launches and cross-functional transformation programs.
Build effective partnerships with Operations, Manufacturing, Quality, Purchasing, Finance, IT, Sustainability and Trade Compliance.
Perform other related duties agreed with functional leadership.
